chunks: Ja'far ibn Muhammad ibn Masrour (mercy of God be upon him) narrated to us that al-Hussein ibn Aamir narrated to him from his uncle Abdullah ibn Aamir from al-Hasan ibn Ali ibn Faddhal from Thaalaba ibn Omar from Omar ibn Eban ar-Rifaee from as-Sabah ibn Sayyaba from Abu Abdillah (peace be upon him)

He said: Indeed, a man loves you but does not know what you say, so Allah will cause him to enter Paradise. And indeed, a man hates you but does not know what you say, so Allah will cause him to enter Hell. And indeed, a man may fill his record with good deeds without performing any of them. I asked: How is that? He said: He passes by some people who are reviling us. When they see him, some of them say to others: This man is from our Shia. And a man from our Shia passes by them, so they throw insults at him and speak ill of him. Allah records for him good deeds because of that until his record is filled without him performing any deeds.
ai.seo_question: How can a person fill their record of good deeds without performing physical acts of worship according to Shia hadith?
ai.summary: This hadith from Fadail al-Shia highlights the concept of 'amal ghayr ma'mul' (deeds without formal action), where mere association with the Ahl al-Bayt through love or hatred incurs divine recompense. It underscores the Shia theological view that the community's identity is so central to cosmic justice that passive recognition or disdain by the broader society directly impacts an individual's spiritual standing, independent of their personal ritual observance.

en.badr-shahin: Ja’far bin Mohammed bin Masrour (r) narrated to us that al-Hussein bin Aamir narrated to him from his uncle Abdullah bin Aamir from al-Hasan bin Ali bin Faddhal from Thaalaba bin Omar from Omar bin Eban arRifaee from as-Sabah bin Sayyaba that Abu Abdullah (a) said:

It happens that a man loves you -the Shia- but he does not know what you say. Accordingly, Allah will allow him to enter Paradise. It also happens that a man hates you but he does not know what you say. Accordingly, Allah will send him to Hell. Hence, a man may fill in his record with good deeds without being doing any of them. (I asked how, and the Imam answered:-) This occurs when he passes by some people while they are reviling at us. As they see him, some of them tell that he is one of the Shia. They then go on railing and reviling at him. Hence, Allah records for him good deeds because of so until his record of good deeds is filled.
